prompt: In a vibrant anime style, the bustling shipyard dock is alive with activity under a clear sky. On the far left, a crane operator in a yellow hard hat leans out of the cab, looking down at the scene below. Next to the massive steel base of the crane stands a foreman in a blue vest, pointing toward the center of the dock where a large cargo container rests. A worker in orange overalls is lifting a heavy chain attached to that container, straining visibly against the weight. Beside this worker, a mechanic in grease-stained coveralls kneels on the concrete, tightening a bolt on a forklift parked nearby. The forklift driver, wearing sunglasses, sits comfortably in the seat, watching the loading process with mild interest. To the right of the forklift, a stack of wooden crates creates a makeshift barrier. Perched atop the highest crate is a stray cat with black and white fur, grooming its paw indifferently. Below the cat, a young apprentice in a green shirt hands a wrench to the kneeling mechanic, their fingers just touching in transfer. In the center background, a large cargo ship looms, its hull painted deep red. A sailor in a white uniform stands on the deck of the ship, waving a flag toward the dock workers. Another sailor next to him holds a clipboard, checking off items as he looks at the manifest. On the dock itself, near the water's edge on the right, a fisherman in a raincoat casts a line into the dark water. A small brown dog runs past the fisherman, chasing a seagull that flies low over the waves. The seagull swoops dangerously close to a pile of ropes coiled neatly on the ground. Near these ropes, an elderly woman in a floral dress sits on a bench, feeding crumbs to a pigeon at her feet. The pigeon pecks eagerly at the ground, ignoring the chaos around it. Standing behind the bench is a security guard in a dark uniform, arms crossed, observing the entire operation with a stern expression. A bicycle leans against the bench leg, its front wheel slightly turned. There is no smoke rising from any machinery. There is no rain falling from the sky. There is no digital clock visible on any structure.
